The '''Algarians''' were the native [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]]. Their society was divided into strict social classes, with upper classes receiving better treatment and services. Marriage between classes was forbidden, and all Algarians and the native [[Xan/Legends|Xan]] were required to wear badges identifying their rank. The Xan were not allowed to ascend past the level of Talent.
